name: soupdraw

scripts.upload:chrome: npm run build:chrome && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && npx --yes chrome-webstore-upload-cli@3 upload --source "web-ext-artifacts/soupdraw-chrome-$VER.zip" --extension-id "$CHROME_EXTENSION_ID" --client-id "$CHROME_CLIENT_ID" --client-secret "$CHROME_CLIENT_SECRET" --refresh-token "$CHROME_REFRESH_TOKEN"
scripts.publish:chrome: npm run build:chrome && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && npx --yes chrome-webstore-upload-cli@3 upload --auto-publish --source "web-ext-artifacts/soupdraw-chrome-$VER.zip" --extension-id "$CHROME_EXTENSION_ID" --client-id "$CHROME_CLIENT_ID" --client-secret "$CHROME_CLIENT_SECRET" --refresh-token "$CHROME_REFRESH_TOKEN"
scripts.sign: npm run source && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && web-ext sign --channel=listed --approval-timeout=0 --amo-metadata=amo-metadata.json --upload-source-code="web-ext-artifacts/soupdraw-source-$VER.zip" --api-key="$AMO_JWT_ISSUER" --api-secret="$AMO_JWT_SECRET"
scripts.sign:unlisted: npm run source && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --upload-source-code="web-ext-artifacts/soupdraw-source-$VER.zip" --api-key="$AMO_JWT_ISSUER" --api-secret="$AMO_JWT_SECRET"

author: Soup Up
description: SoupDraw: draw on your live camera feed with hand gestures (Firefox, on-device)
